title: Logs
description: Bounded untrusted text, filtered by service, severity and time.

notes: Treat remote text as data. Escape tags, preserve monospace line wrapping and bound visible bytes/entries.
Keyboard-focusable scroll region, continuation cursor, collection time and unsupported backend reason. No default raw-log persistence.
Log filtering remains read-only. Missing data and disconnect are not healthy empty results.

title: Owned audit history
description: Review requests, approvals, outcomes and observations without secrets.
notes: Only owner-scoped records/cursors; show exact target/revision, timestamps and approver/requester attribution.
Redact secrets; bounded retention/output; operation record remains available during MCP outage.
Audit history never claims an approval based on confirm:true alone.
